Dear Phil,

I have a question about mirt package. Where i learn about methods that you use in fscore function? In adition, which the diference between this scores and these get by fitted(model)?

I'm sorry because my inglish is very bad, i write in spanish, i hope you undertand me

Me gustaria saber donde puedo aprender sobre los metodos de estimacion que usa la funcion fscore del paquete mirt. Ademas, cual es la diferencia entre los valores obtenidos por esa funcion y los que se obtienen usando la funcion fitted(modelo)?

Reply:

Hi,

Don't worry about not speaking English too well, if I don't understand what you are asking then I'll let you know. Google's Translate service did an excellent job translating your Spanish text to English by the way, so that may be an option if you need it in the future.

There are several books available which can help to understand the more common methods, such as Embretson, S. E. & Reise, S. P. Item Response Theory for Psychologists Erlbaum, 2000, or de Ayala, R. J. The theory and practice of item response theory Guilford Press, 2009. For the method = 'WLE' there is an article by Warm in the ?mirt reference section on how that works, so you'll have to refer to that article to understand that particular approach, and Thissen et al. (1995) are how the method = 'EAPsum' works. Hope that helps!

Phil
